profile.headline: Software Engineer at TMC Transportation
profile.summary: Software Engineer at TMC Transportation focused on building data-driven applications and internal tools using technologies across frontend, backend, databases, and cloud workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer Intern at TMC, I deliver full-stack web solutions, collaborating with teams to define requirements and optimize application performance and user experience. I work on both front-end and back-end development, ensuring smooth, reliable deployments in an Agile environment.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.locationName: Des Moines, Iowa, United States · On-site
positions.description: I supported network security through firewall management and subnet configuration while also automating cloud processes. I also led a project to optimize network access across multiple buildings, overseeing everything from configuration to troubleshooting
